evidence: Reviewed pipeline causality, token-safety premises, queue recurrence/drain derivation, idle-time counterexample, and monotonic session-token argument.

limitations: Internal source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical review only; no external database-vendor, distributed-systems, networking, storage, security, reliability, application, or production review is claimed. Conclusions remain conditional on history and position semantics, truthful frontiers, snapshot visibility, publication scope, clock bounds, workload and rate units, parallel-apply gaps, session-token propagation, topology and failover ancestry, cache behavior, implementation, configuration, and future version drift.
